title: SB0318 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 10; Title 33; Title 38; Title 39; Title 40; Title 50 and Title 70, relative to the carrying of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2021-01-22; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514134135 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/112/Bill/SB0318.pdf (LegiScan doc 2254784))
provenance.note: Draft as filed 2021-01-22 (SB 318, twin of HB 18). Summary line says 'As introduced'. Sections 3-4 change 'defense' to 'exception' in 39-17-1308(a)(10) and (b). Effective July 1, 2021.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)): (1) It is an exception to the application of subdivision (a) if a person:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)): (A) Is legally in possession of the firearm; and
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)): (B) Is not prohibited from purchasing a firearm in the person's state of residence.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)): (2) A person who meets the elements of subdivision (g)(1) is entitled to the same defenses and exceptions as a person who has been issued a handgun carry permit pursuant to § 39-17-1351, for purposes of any offenses in this part; title 50, chapter 3; or title 70.
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1308(a)): deleting the language "It is a defense to the application" and substituting the language "It is an exception to the application".
